item.title: Trump deploys a top White House attack dog in push to kill NYC's congestion pricing
item.description: Congestion pricing led to big reduction in Manhattan traffic over the last year, but the president has vowed to kill the tolling program. The Trump administration attorney now trying to kill congestion pricing is also working on cases to restrict birthright citizenship and defend the president's right to deploy the National Gaurd into states. [ more › ]

item.title: Subzero wind chills make for dangerously cold weekend in NYC area, officials warn
item.description: The East River is partially frozen in New York City on Feb. 4, 2026. Real-feel temperatures overnight could drop as low as minus 20 degrees. [ more › ]

item.title: Luigi Mangione to stand trial on state murder charges in June, ahead of federal case
item.description: Luigi Mangione appears for a suppression of evidence hearing in the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson in Manhattan Criminal Court on December 12, 2025 in New York City. The trial is slated to begin three months before a separate trial around the corner in federal court, where Mangione faces stalking charges. [ more › ]

item.title: Bring the Winter Olympics back to New York, state lawmaker says
item.description: As the Winter Olympics kick off in Italy, one state legislator wants to bring them back to New York. The plan would split the Winter Games between Lake Placid in the Adirondacks and New York City. [ more › ]

item.title: Mamdani taps NYC school nurses, peers to bring people indoors during ‘lethal cold' stretch
item.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani holds a press conference to provide a winter weather briefing at the New York City Emergency Management Department on Friday, Feb. 6, 2026. The mayor urged homeless New Yorkers to "come inside" as 17 people have died outside and temps are set to plunge to minus 20 this weekend. [ more › ]
